# PURPOSE

This code is intended to quality check plot data year-by-year for protocols listed below. These protocols have been cleaned using the Clean+Merge.Rmd script.

-   Surface Fuels - 1000Hr

-   Surface Fuels - Duff_Litter

-   Surface Fuels - Fine

-   Post Burn Severity

-   Trees - Individuals (metric)

-   Density - Quadrats (metric)

-   Density - Belts (metric)

-   Cover - Species Composition (metric)

-   Cover - Points (metric)

### Create Function {.hidden}

```{r qaqc function, include=FALSE}
## Source Code
#Pull in source code that creates QAQC functions and builds an empty error table.
source(paste0(here(), "/scripts/2_QAQC/qaqc_function.R"))

###################################################################################

# Edit blank data frame for preferred error log template.
errors_blank <- data.frame("SavedQuery" = "", 
                           "AdminUnit_Name" = "", 
                           "SampleEvent_TreatmentUnit" = "", 
                           "Macroplot_Name" = "", 
                           "SampleEvent_Date" = as.Date(NA), 
                           "Error" = "", 
                           "Fixed" = "", 
                           "Explanation" = "", 
                           "Queryers" = "")

# Edit error group. Duplicate errors will be grouped by these columns.
errors_group <- c("SavedQuery", "AdminUnit_Name", "Macroplot_Name", "SampleEvent_Date", "Error")
```

### Filter Data {.hidden}

```{r filter data, include=FALSE}
# Clean up data frame
df_names <- c("Fuels1000_all", "FuelsDuffLitt_all", "FuelsFine_all",  "PostBurn_all", "Trees_all", "Seedlings_all", "Shrubs_all", "HerbsSpComp_all", "HerbsPoints_all")

for (name in df_names) {
  # load data
  current_df <- get(name)
  
  # filter data for target park
  filtered_df <- current_df %>% 
    mutate(SampleEvent_Date = as.Date(SampleEvent_Date)) %>% 
    mutate(SampleEvent_Date_Year = year(SampleEvent_Date)) %>% 
    relocate(SampleEvent_Date_Year, .after = SampleEvent_Date)
  
  # rename and save
  new_name <- sub("_all$", "_data", name)
  assign(new_name, filtered_df)
}
```

# PROTOCOL - SURFACE FUELS

## 1000HR (CWD)

This code conducts quality control checks on coarse woody debris (CWD) surface fuels data within the "Surface Fuels - 1000Hr" data set.

It checks for errors in: headers, decay class values, diameters, fuel constants, duplicates, slope, and transects.

### Fuel 1000 Header

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect header information entered for FMH plots.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that NumTran = 4

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Fuels1000_data %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Purpose == "Fire Monitoring Handbook")
query <- "Fuel 1000 Header"
query_message <- "Number of Transects" 
values_data <- data$MethodData_NumTran
values_valid <- 4
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_NumTran <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that TranLen = 50 (or very close).

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Fuels1000_data
query <- "Fuel 1000 Header" 
query_message <- "Transect Length" 
values_data <- data$MethodData_TranLen
values_valid <- 50  
values_check <-values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_TranLen <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel 1000 DecayClass

[Problem:]{.underline} Logs are missing decay class.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that DecayCl = 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5. DecayCl should not be blank

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- Fuels1000_data
query <- "Fuel 1000 DecayCl"
query_message <- paste0("Log ", data$MethodData_LogNum, ". ", "Decay Class")
values_data <- data$MethodData_DecayCl
values_valid <- c(1:5)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_DecayCl <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel 1000 Diameter

[Problem:]{.underline}  Values for diameter are missing or unreasonable.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that diameter values are ≥ 3.0. Diameter should not be blank

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- Fuels1000_data
query <- "Fuel 1000 Dia"
query_message <- paste0("Log ", data$MethodData_LogNum, ". ", "Diameter")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Dia
values_valid <- min(3)
values_check <- values_data >= values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_Dia <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel 1000 LogNo

[Problem:]{.underline} "Duplicate" data exists due to multiple 1000 hr fuels with the same transect / diameter / decay class. Log Numbers are missing (which would differentiate 1000 hr fuels).

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check for duplicate logs across Date, Macroplot, Transect, LogNum, Dia [and]{.underline} DecayCl.

```{r}
# Check for log duplication and store results in new column
data_temp <- Fuels1000_data %>%
  get_dupes(SampleEvent_Date, Macroplot_Name, MethodData_Transect, MethodData_LogNum, MethodData_Dia, MethodData_DecayCl)

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(Fuels1000_data, data_temp, all.x = T)
data$dupe_count[is.na(data$dupe_count)] <- 0
query <- "Fuel 1000 LogNo" 
query_message <- paste0("Log ", data$MethodData_LogNum, ". ", "Transect ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ",  "Dia ", data$MethodData_Dia, ". ",  "DecayCl ", data$MethodData_DecayCl, ". ", "Duplicates")
values_data <- data$dupe_count
values_valid <- 0
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_LogNo <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel 1000 Slope

[Problem:]{.underline}  Values for slope are missing or unreasonable.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Slope values are reasonable. Slope is measured in percent, where a 45 degree angle is 100% slope. Slope should generally not exceed 50%.

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- Fuels1000_data
query <- "Fuel 1000 Slope"
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Slope")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Slope
values_valid <- seq(-50, 50, by = 1)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_Slope <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel 1000 Transect

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect values entered for transect.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Transect = 1, 2, 3, or 4

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- Fuels1000_data
query <- "Fuel 1000 Transect"
query_message <- "Transect Number"
values_data <- data$MethodData_Transect
values_valid <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Fuels1000_Transect <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel 1000 Errors

```{r}
# Save to master error list
errors_Fuels1000 <- rbind(errors_Fuels1000_NumTran, errors_blank, errors_Fuels1000_TranLen, errors_blank, errors_Fuels1000_DecayCl, errors_blank, errors_Fuels1000_Dia, errors_blank, errors_Fuels1000_LogNo, errors_blank, errors_Fuels1000_Slope, errors_blank, errors_Fuels1000_Transect)

remove(errors_Fuels1000_NumTran, errors_Fuels1000_TranLen, errors_Fuels1000_DecayCl, errors_Fuels1000_Dia, errors_Fuels1000_LogNo, errors_Fuels1000_Slope, errors_Fuels1000_Transect)
```

## DUFF LITTER (DL)

This code conducts quality control checks on duff litter (DL) surface fuels data within the "Surface Fuels - Duff_Litter" data set.

It checks for errors in: headers, fuel constants, offset values, sample locations, transects, litter values, and duff values.

### Fuel DL Complete

[Problem:]{.underline} Sample points are missing from data.

-   **Incomplete data (invalid):** If protocols have fewer data points than expected, select data may be missing (e.g. data exists for 4 fuels transects but only 3 transects were entered). [Make sure to find and enter this data.]{.underline}

-   **Incomplete data (valid):** Protocols may intentionally have fewer data points than expected (e.g. it was decided that certain plots would only have 3 fuels transects instead of 4). [Make sure this is noted in the comment field of the protocol header]{.underline}.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Group by Macroplot_Name and SampleEvent_Date. Calculate number of data points per plot. Check that data_points = 40

```{r}
# Filter NA values. Add number of data points and store in new column
data_temp <- FuelsDuffLitt_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(MethodData_LittDep)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MethodData_DuffDep)) %>% 
  group_by(Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise("data_points" = n())

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(FuelsDuffLitt_data, data_temp, by = c("Macroplot_Name","SampleEvent_Date"), all = T)%>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Purpose == "Fire Monitoring Handbook")
query <- "Fuel DL Complete" 
query_message <- paste0(data$Macroplot_Name, ". Date = ",data$SampleEvent_Date, ". Complete Sample Locations")
values_data <- data$data_points
values_valid <- 40
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Complete <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel DL Header

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect header information entered for FMH plots.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that NumTran = 4

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- FuelsDuffLitt_data %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Purpose == "Fire Monitoring Handbook")
query <- "Fuel DL Header" 
query_message <- "FMH plot. Number of Transects"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_NumTran  
values_valid <- 4    
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsDuffLitt_NumTran <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel DL Transect

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect values entered for transect.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Transect = 1, 2, 3, or 4

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- FuelsDuffLitt_data
query <- "Fuel DL Transect"
query_message <- "Transect Number"
values_data <- data$MethodData_Transect
values_valid <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Transect <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel DL Values

[Problem:]{.underline}  Values for litter and duff depth are missing or unreasonable.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Sort by LittDep. Check that litter depth values are reasonable.

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- FuelsDuffLitt_data
query <- "Fuel DL Values LittDep" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Sample Location = ", data$MethodData_SampLoc, ". ", "Litter Depth")
values_data <- data$MethodData_LittDep
values_valid <- 6
values_check <- values_data <= values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsDuffLitt_LittDep <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Sort by DuffDep. Check that duff depth values are reasonable.

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- FuelsDuffLitt_data
query <- "Fuel DL Values DuffDep" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Sample Location = ", data$MethodData_SampLoc, ". ", "Duff Depth")
values_data <- data$MethodData_DuffDep
values_valid <- 10
values_check <- values_data <= values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsDuffLitt_DuffDep <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine Values Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
# Combine
errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Values <- unique(rbind(errors_FuelsDuffLitt_LittDep, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_DuffDep))

remove(errors_FuelsDuffLitt_LittDep, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_DuffDep)
```

### Fuel DL Errors

```{r}
# Save to master error list 
errors_FuelsDuffLitt <- rbind(errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Complete, errors_blank, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_NumTran, errors_blank, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Transect, errors_blank, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Values)

remove(errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Complete, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_NumTran, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Transect, errors_FuelsDuffLitt_Values)
```

## FINE FUELS (FWD)

This code conducts quality control checks on fine woody debris (FWD) surface fuels data within the "Surface Fuels - Fine" data set.

It checks for errors in: headers, azimuth, fuel constants, slope, transects, and One/Ten/Hundred Hour count values.

### Fuel Fine Complete

[Problem:]{.underline} Sample points are missing from data.

-   **Incomplete data (invalid):** If protocols have fewer data points than expected, select data may be missing (e.g. data exists for 4 fuels transects but only 3 transects were entered). [Make sure to find and enter this data.]{.underline}

-   **Incomplete data (valid):** Protocols may intentionally have fewer data points than expected (e.g. it was decided that certain plots would only have 3 fuels transects instead of 4). [Make sure this is noted in the comment field of the protocol header]{.underline}.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Group by Macroplot_Name and SampleEvent_Date. Calculate number of data points per plot. Check that data_points = 4

```{r}
# Filter NA values. Add number of data points and store in new column
data_temp <- FuelsFine_data %>% 
  group_by(Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise("data_points" = n())

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(FuelsFine_data, data_temp, by = c("Macroplot_Name","SampleEvent_Date"), all = T) %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Purpose == "Fire Monitoring Handbook")
query <- "Fuel Fine Complete"
query_message <- paste0(data$Macroplot_Name, ". Date = ",data$SampleEvent_Date, ". Complete Transects")
values_data <- data$data_points
values_valid <- 4
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_Complete <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Fuel Fine Header

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect header information entered for FMH plots.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that NumTran = 4

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- FuelsFine_data %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Purpose == "Fire Monitoring Handbook")
query <- "Fuel Fine Header" 
query_message <- "Number of Transects"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_NumTran  
values_valid <- 4    
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_NumTran <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that OneHrTranLen = 6

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Header" 
query_message <- "One Hour Transect Length"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_OneHrTranLen
values_valid <- 6
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_OneHrTranLen <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that TenHrTranLen = 6

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Header" 
query_message <- "Ten Hour Transect Length"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_TenHrTranLen
values_valid <- 6
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_TenHrTranLen <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that HunHrTranLen = 12

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Header" 
query_message <- "Hundred Hour Transect Length"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_HunHrTranLen
values_valid <- 12
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_HunHrTranLen <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine Header Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
# Combine
errors_FuelsFine_Header <- unique(rbind(errors_FuelsFine_NumTran, errors_FuelsFine_OneHrTranLen, errors_FuelsFine_TenHrTranLen, errors_FuelsFine_HunHrTranLen))

remove(errors_FuelsFine_NumTran, errors_FuelsFine_OneHrTranLen, errors_FuelsFine_TenHrTranLen, errors_FuelsFine_HunHrTranLen)

if(nrow(errors_FuelsFine_Header) > 1) {
  errors_FuelsFine_Header <- errors_FuelsFine_Header %>%
    filter(Error != "No Error")
} else {
  errors_FuelsFine_Header <- errors_FuelsFine_Header}
```

### Fuel Fine Slope

[Problem:]{.underline}  Values for slope are missing or unreasonable.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Slope values are reasonable. Slope is measured in percent, where a 45 degree angle is 100% slope. Slope should generally not exceed 50%.

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Slope"
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Slope")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Slope
values_valid <- seq(-50, 50, by = 1)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_Slope_Value <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check for consistency in slope values across Fuels 1000 and Fuels Fine protocols.

```{r}
data_temp1 <- Fuels1000_data %>%
  group_by(Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date, MethodData_Transect, MethodData_Slope) %>%
  dplyr::summarise("Macroplot_Name" = unique(Macroplot_Name),
            "Transect" = unique(MethodData_Transect)) %>%
  mutate(Slope_1000 = MethodData_Slope) %>%
  arrange(Macroplot_Name, MethodData_Transect) %>%
  select(!MethodData_Slope)

data_temp2 <- FuelsFine_data %>%
  group_by(Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date, MethodData_Transect, MethodData_Slope) %>%
  dplyr::summarise("Macroplot_Name" = unique(Macroplot_Name),
            "Transect" = unique(MethodData_Transect)) %>%
  mutate(Slope_fine = MethodData_Slope) %>%
  arrange(Macroplot_Name, MethodData_Transect) %>%
  select(!MethodData_Slope)

data_temp <- merge(data_temp1, data_temp2, all.y = T)
data_temp <- data_temp %>% 
  mutate(Slope_1000 = ifelse(is.na(Slope_1000), Slope_fine, Slope_1000))
remove(data_temp1, data_temp2)

# Set parameters
data <- merge(FuelsFine_data, data_temp, by = c("Macroplot_Name", "SampleEvent_Date", "MethodData_Transect"), all = T)
query <- "Fuel Fine Slope"
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "CWD slope = ", data$Slope_1000, ". ", "FWD slope")
values_data <- data$Slope_fine
values_valid <- data$Slope_1000
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_Slope_FineCWD <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine Slope Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
# Combine
errors_FuelsFine_Slope <- unique(rbind(errors_FuelsFine_Slope_Value, errors_FuelsFine_Slope_FineCWD))

remove(errors_FuelsFine_Slope_Value, errors_FuelsFine_Slope_FineCWD)

if(nrow(errors_FuelsFine_Slope) > 1) {
  errors_FuelsFine_Slope <- errors_FuelsFine_Slope %>%
    filter(Error != "No Error")
} else {
  errors_FuelsFine_Slope <- errors_FuelsFine_Slope}
```

### Fuel Fine Transect

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect values entered for transect.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Transect = 1, 2, 3, or 4

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Transect"
query_message <- "Transect Number"
values_data <- data$MethodData_Transect
values_valid <- c(1, 2, 3, 4)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors

```

### Fuel Fine Values

[Problem:]{.underline} Values for One, Ten, and Hundred Hour fuel counts are missing or unreasonable.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that One Hour values are reasonable.

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Values OneHr" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Possible outlier. One Hour Count")
values_data <- data$MethodData_OneHr
values_valid <- seq(0, 50, by = 1)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_OneHr <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that Ten Hour values are reasonable.

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- FuelsFine_data
query <- "Fuel Fine Values TenHr" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Possible outlier. Ten Hour Count")
values_data <- data$MethodData_TenHr
values_valid <- seq(0, 20, by = 1)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_FuelsFine_TenHr <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that Hundred Hour values are reasonable.


# PROTOCOL - TREES

This code conducts quality control checks on tree data within the "Trees - Individuals (metric)" data set.

It checks for errors in: headers, crown base height, crown class, damage codes, DBH, dead and down, duplicates, subplot fractions, height, life form, non-post severity, post severity, status, and user variables.

### Trees Header

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect header information entered for FMH plots.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that MacroPlotSize = 0.1 (hectares)
-   Plots are 20m by 50m. 1,000 square meters = 0.1 hectares. Plot size is used to calculate tree density and basal area.

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- Trees_data
query <- "Trees Header" 
query_message <- "Macro Plot Size"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_MacroPlotSize
values_valid <- 0.1
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_MacroPlotSize <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that SnagPlotSize = 0.1 (hectares)
-   Plots are 20m by 50m. 1,000 square meters = 0.1 hectares. Plot size is used to calculate tree density and basal area.

```{r}
# Set parameters  
data <- Trees_data
query <- "Trees Header" 
query_message <- "Snag Plot Size"  
values_data <- data$MethodData_SnagPlotSize
values_valid <- 0.1    
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_SnagPlotSize <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine Header Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
# Save to master error list 
errors_Trees_Header <- unique(rbind(errors_Trees_MacroPlotSize, errors_Trees_SnagPlotSize))

remove(errors_Trees_MacroPlotSize, errors_Trees_SnagPlotSize)

if(nrow(errors_Trees_Header) > 1) {
  errors_Trees_Header <- errors_Trees_Header %>%
    filter(Error != "No Error")
} else {
  errors_Trees_Header <- errors_Trees_Header}
```

### Trees DBH

[Problem]{.underline}: DBH values for standing trees do not exist. DBH is used to calculate basal area. If DBH is missing, basal area calculations will be wrong.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Filter to exclude DD trees. Check that DBH ≥ 2.5. DBH should not be blank

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Trees_data %>% 
  filter(!MethodData_CrwnCl %in% c("DD", "BBD", "CUS")) %>% 
  filter(MethodData_Status == "L")
query <- "Trees DBH" 
query_message <- paste0("Tag ", data$MethodData_TagNo, ". ", "DBH")
values_data <- data$MethodData_DBH
values_valid <- min(2.5)
values_check <- values_data >= values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_DBH <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Trees Duplicates

[Problem]{.underline}: Duplicate tree tag numbers entered for a plot visit. Number of trees (number of unique tag numbers) per plot are needed to calculate tree density. If tags are duplicated, tree count and densities will be wrong.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check for duplicate tree tags across Date, Macroplot, SubFrac [and]{.underline} TagNo.

```{r}
# Check for tag duplication and store results in new column
data_temp <- Trees_data %>% 
  get_dupes(SampleEvent_Date, Macroplot_Name, MethodData_SubFrac, MethodData_TagNo)

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(Trees_data, data_temp, all.x = T)
data$dupe_count[is.na(data$dupe_count)] <- 0
query <- "Trees Duplicates" 
query_message <- paste0("Tag ", data$MethodData_TagNo, ". ", "Duplicates")
values_data <- data$dupe_count
values_valid <- 0
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_Duplicate <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Trees Status

[Problem:]{.underline} Species do not have an entry for status or have an entry that we don’t use.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Sort by Status. Check that Status = L or D

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Trees_data
query <- "Trees Status" 
query_message <- paste0("Tag ", data$MethodData_TagNo, ". ", "Status")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Status
values_valid <- c("L", "D")
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_Status <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Trees SubFrac

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect subplot fraction entered for trees. Subplot Fraction is used to calculate sample area, which is used for tree density and basal area calculations.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   SubFrac should be ≤ 1

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Trees_data
query <- "Trees SubFrac" 
query_message <- paste0("Tag ", data$MethodData_TagNo, ". ", "Subplot Fraction")
values_data <- data$MethodData_SubFrac
values_valid <- 1
values_check <- values_data <= values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_SubFrac_All <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   If DBH = overstory, then check that SubFrac = 1

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Trees_data %>% 
   filter(MethodData_DBH > 15.0, MethodData_SubFrac <= 1)
query <- "Trees SubFrac" 
query_message <- paste0("Tag ", data$MethodData_TagNo, ". ", "DBH = overstory. Subplot Fraction")
values_data <- data$MethodData_SubFrac
values_valid <- 1
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_SubFrac_Overstory <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   If DBH = pole, then check that SubFrac = 0.25

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- Trees_data %>% 
  filter(MethodData_DBH <= 15.0)
query <- "Trees SubFrac" 
query_message <- paste0("DBH = pole. Subplot Fraction")
values_data <- data$MethodData_SubFrac
values_valid <- 0.25
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_Trees_SubFrac_Pole <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine SubFrac Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
# Combine
errors_Trees_SubFrac <- unique(rbind(errors_Trees_SubFrac_All, errors_Trees_SubFrac_Overstory, errors_Trees_SubFrac_Pole))

remove(errors_Trees_SubFrac_All, errors_Trees_SubFrac_Overstory, errors_Trees_SubFrac_Pole)

if(nrow(errors_Trees_SubFrac) > 1) {
  errors_Trees_SubFrac <- errors_Trees_SubFrac %>%
    filter(Error != "No Error")
} else {
  errors_Trees_SubFrac <- errors_Trees_SubFrac}
```

## Trees Errors

```{r}
errors_Trees <- rbind(errors_Trees_Header, errors_blank, errors_Trees_DBH, errors_blank, errors_Trees_Duplicate, errors_Trees_Status, errors_blank, errors_Trees_SubFrac)

remove(errors_Trees_Header, errors_Trees_DBH, errors_Trees_Duplicate, errors_Trees_Status, errors_Trees_SubFrac)
```

# PROTOCOL - COVER POINTS

This code conducts quality control checks on point line intercept herbaceous data within the "Cover - Points (metric)" data set.

It checks for errors in: height, order, points, status, tape, and transect.

### Cvr Points Complete

[Problem:]{.underline} Sample points are missing from data.

-   **Incomplete data (invalid):** If protocols have fewer data points than expected, select data may be missing (e.g. data exists for 156 points on the herb line but 166 points are expected). [Make sure to find and enter this data.]{.underline}

-   **Incomplete data (valid):** Protocols may intentionally have fewer data points than expected (e.g. it was decided that certain plots would only have 1 herb transect instead of 2). [Make sure this is noted in the comment field of the protocol header]{.underline}.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Filter by Order = 1. Group by Macroplot_Name and SampleEvent_Date. Calculate number of data points per plot. Check that data_points = 100 (Grasslands, Shrublands) or 166 (Forests)

```{r}
# Filter NA values. Add number of data points and store in new column
data_temp <- HerbsPoints_data %>%
  filter(MethodData_Order == 1,
         Macroplot_Type %in% c("Grassland", "Shrubland")) %>%
  group_by(AdminUnit_Name, Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date, MethodData_Transect) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise("data_points" = n())

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(HerbsPoints_data, data_temp, by = c("AdminUnit_Name", "Macroplot_Name", "SampleEvent_Date", "MethodData_Transect"), all = T) %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Type %in% c("Grassland", "Shrubland"))
query <- "Cvr Pts Complete" 
query_message <- paste0(data$Macroplot_Name, ". Date = ",data$SampleEvent_Date, ". Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". Total Points") 
values_data <- data$data_points
values_valid <- 100
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Complete_Grassland <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

```{r}
# Filter NA values. Add number of data points and store in new column
data_temp <- HerbsPoints_data %>%
  filter(MethodData_Order == 1,
         Macroplot_Type %in% c("Forest")) %>%
  group_by(AdminUnit_Name, Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date, MethodData_Transect) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise("data_points" = n())

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(HerbsPoints_data, data_temp, by = c("AdminUnit_Name", "Macroplot_Name", "SampleEvent_Date", "MethodData_Transect"), all = T) %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Type %in% c("Forest"))
query <- "Cvr Pts Complete" 
query_message <- paste0(data$Macroplot_Name, ". Date = ",data$SampleEvent_Date, ". Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". Total Points") 
values_data <- data$data_points
values_valid <- 166
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Complete_Forest <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine Complete Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
errors_HerbsPoints_Complete <- unique(rbind(errors_HerbsPoints_Complete_Grassland, errors_HerbsPoints_Complete_Forest)) %>% 
  arrange(AdminUnit_Name)

remove(errors_HerbsPoints_Complete_Grassland, errors_HerbsPoints_Complete_Forest)

if(nrow(errors_HerbsPoints_Complete) > 1) {
  errors_HerbsPoints_Complete <- errors_HerbsPoints_Complete %>%
    filter(Error != "No Error")
} else {
  errors_HerbsPoints_Complete <- errors_HerbsPoints_Complete}
```

### Cvr Points Height

[Problem:]{.underline} Height measurements entered incorrectly.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Sort by Height. Check that Height ≤ 2

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- HerbsPoints_data %>% 
   filter(!is.na(MethodData_Height))

query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Point = ", data$MethodData_Point, ". ", "Order = ", data$MethodData_Order, ". ", "Species = ", data$Species_SymbolLocal, ". ", "Height")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Height
values_valid <- 2
values_check <- values_data <= values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Height_Max <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Sort by Height. Check that Height is measured at 0.05 increments.

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- HerbsPoints_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(MethodData_Height))
query <- "Cvr Pts Height" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Point = ", data$MethodData_Point, ". ", "Order = ", data$MethodData_Order, ". ", "Species = ", data$Species_SymbolLocal, ". ", "Precision error. Height")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Height
values_valid <- c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00, 1.05, 1.10, 1.15, 1.20, 1.25, 1.30, 1.35, 1.40, 1.45, 1.50, 1.55, 1.60, 1.65, 1.70, 1.75, 1.80, 1.85, 1.90, 1.95, 2.00)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Height_Precision <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Cvr Points Point

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect point numbers entered or point number missing.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Point is between 1 and 166

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- HerbsPoints_data
query <- "Cvr Pts Point" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Order = ", data$MethodData_Order, ". ", "Point")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Point
values_valid <- seq(1, 166, by = 1)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Number <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

-   Check that points are not missing / there are no extra points

```{r}
# Filter NA values. Add number of hits and store in new column
expected_sum <- 166 * (1 + 166) / 2

data_temp <- HerbsPoints_data %>%
  filter(is.na(MethodData_Order)|MethodData_Order == 1,
         Macroplot_Type == "Forest") %>% 
  group_by(Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date, MethodData_Transect) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(across(MethodData_Point, sum))

data_temp <- data_temp %>% 
  mutate(Missing = abs(expected_sum - MethodData_Point)) %>% 
  select(!MethodData_Point)

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(HerbsPoints_data, data_temp, by = c("Macroplot_Name", "SampleEvent_Date", "MethodData_Transect"), all = T) %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Type == "Forest")
query <- "Cvr Pts Point" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Order = 1. Missing/Extra Point") 
values_data <- data$Missing
values_valid <- 0
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Missing_Forest <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

```{r}
# Filter NA values. Add number of hits and store in new column
expected_sum <- 100 * (1 + 100) / 2

data_temp <- HerbsPoints_data %>%
  filter(is.na(MethodData_Order)|MethodData_Order == 1,
         Macroplot_Type== "Grassland") %>% 
  group_by(Macroplot_Name, SampleEvent_Date, MethodData_Transect) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(across(MethodData_Point, sum))

data_temp <- data_temp %>% 
  mutate(Missing = abs(expected_sum - MethodData_Point)) %>% 
  select(!MethodData_Point)

# Set parameters 
data <- merge(HerbsPoints_data, data_temp, by = c("Macroplot_Name", "SampleEvent_Date", "MethodData_Transect"), all = T) %>% 
  filter(Macroplot_Type == "Grassland")
query <- "Cvr Pts Point"

values_data <- data$Missing
values_valid <- 0
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Missing_Grassland <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

#### Combine Point Errors {.hidden}

```{r}
errors_HerbsPoints_Point <- unique(rbind(errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Number, errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Missing_Forest, errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Missing_Grassland))

remove(errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Number, errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Missing_Forest, errors_HerbsPoints_Point_Missing_Grassland)

if(nrow(errors_HerbsPoints_Point) > 1) {
  errors_HerbsPoints_Point <- errors_HerbsPoints_Point %>%
    filter(Error != "No Error")
} else {
  errors_HerbsPoints_Point <- errors_HerbsPoints_Point}
```

### Cvr Points Tape

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect tape numbers entered or tape number missing.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Tape is between 0.3 and 49.8, at 0.3 increments

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- HerbsPoints_data
query <- "Cvr Pts Tape" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect = ", data$MethodData_Transect, ". ", "Point = ", data$MethodData_Point, ". ", "Correct Tape Value = ", data$MethodData_Point * 0.3, "; ", "Tape")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Tape
```

### Cvr Points Transect

[Problem:]{.underline} Incorrect transect numbers entered or transect number missing.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that Transect = 1 or 2

```{r}
# Set parameters 
data <- HerbsPoints_data
query <- "Cvr Pts Transect" 
query_message <- paste0("Transect")
values_data <- data$MethodData_Transect
values_valid <- c(1, 2)
values_check <- values_data %in% values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Transect <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

### Cvr Points Zero

[Problem:]{.underline}  Values entered for columns which should be blank.

[Procedure:]{.underline}

-   Check that CanopyLayer = blank

```{r}
# Set parameters
data <- HerbsPoints_data
data$MethodData_CanopyLayer[is.na(data$MethodData_CanopyLayer)] <- ""
query <- "Cvr Pts Zero/NA"
query_message <- "Canopy Layer"
values_data <- data$MethodData_CanopyLayer
values_valid <- ""
values_check <- values_data == values_valid

# Identify errors
errors_HerbsPoints_Zero <- qaqc(data, query, query_message, values_check)
```

```{r}
# Create conditional formatting rules
errors_all_cf <- errors_all %>% 
  mutate(Color = ifelse((grepl("PROTOCOL", errors_all$SavedQuery) == TRUE), 
                        "Protocol",
                        ifelse(SavedQuery == "", NA, "Standard")))

# Add conditional formating to ouput
errors_all <- condformat(errors_all_cf[1:(nrow(errors_all_cf)), 1:ncol(errors_all_cf)]) %>%
  rule_fill_discrete(columns = 1:(ncol(errors_all_cf)-1),
                     expression = (errors_all_cf$Color),
                     colours = c("Standard"="#C6E0B4",
                                 "Protocol" = "#969696"),
                     na.value = "#FFFFFF") %>% 
  select(!(Color))
```
